62639.subject: Data Processing
62639.question_text: A student was given an assignment which involved typesetting a passage at home using a laptop computer. The student was required to bring the soft copy of the assignment in a flash drive with volume label STUDENT ASSIGNMENT to the school. Highlight the steps the student would take to: (a) save the typeset work in the flash drive (b) create a folder named ASSIGNMENTS on the desktop of  computer in the school's computer laboratory and save the typeset assignment in the folder (c) prit the assignment from the folder created in 5(b).
62639.explanation:
a) Steps the student would take to save the typeset work in the flash drive

  • Insert the flash drive into the USB port of the computer.
  • Click the " Save In " drop-down menu at the top of the save as a dialog box
  • Navigate to and click the flash drive. The flash drive is typically labeled " E " or " F ".
  • Type the name of your document into the file name field and click " save " to save the file to the flash drive.

(b). To create a folder named ASSIGNMENTS on the desktop of a computer.

  • Choose Start Document
  • click the new folder button in the command bar. 
  • Type ASSIGNMENTS.
  • press the Enter key to make the new name stick
  • with your document open; click file > Save As.
  • under Save As, select where you want to create your new folder.
  • In the Save dialog box that opens, click New folder 
  • Type STUDENTS _ ASSIGNMENT and press Enter.
  • Click save.

(c)Printing the assignment from the folder created in (5b) 

  • Open the folder that contains the Word documents you want to print.
  • Press(Ctrl), and select the file you want to print
  • right-click the selection and select Print from the shortcut menu.
  • Select the desired print options and click ok. ( the selected options will apply to all the documents).
